tools.name: search_addresses
tools.description: Lists the addresses at a UK postcode, each with its UPRN and display address. Broadband availability differs per property, so the other tools take a UPRN and display address to answer for one exact property.

tools.name: find_broadband_deals
tools.description: Returns the broadband deals available at a UK address or postcode: a best value, cheapest and fastest pick plus a provider-varied list. Each deal has its monthly price, contract length, speed and true whole-contract cost, with intro pricing, later price rises and setup fees included. Optional filter

tools.name: check_if_overpaying
tools.description: Compares what a user pays for broadband, or a renewal price their provider quoted, against comparable deals available at their address. Returns a computed verdict, the saving over 24 months and the best alternatives, each with its true cost over 24 months.

tools.name: get_deal_details
tools.description: Returns the full terms of one deal from an earlier result: setup costs, price-rise terms, what happens after the intro period, the whole-contract total and whether the deal is available at the user's address.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_addresses" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
